brief:
Settlers attacked the homes of Palestinian citizens in the Saffa area of Beit Ummar town north of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred in a residential zone where Israeli settlement expansion has created ongoing tensions with Palestinian communities.

The attack is part of a pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian civilians and property in the occupied West Bank, particularly in areas adjacent to or surrounded by Israeli settlements.
title: Settlers attack Palestinian homes in Beit Ummar north of Hebron
